Growing private ownership and fragmented international oversight raise difficult questions about infrastructure security, maintenance and accountability.

items.title: SpaceX Agrees to Acquire Nationwide 800 MHz Spectrum for Starlink Mobile
items.summary: SpaceX has agreed to acquire nationwide 800 MHz spectrum licenses from Grain Management in a deal reportedly worth $8 billion, potentially expanding Starlink Mobile's ability to integrate satellite and terrestrial connectivity.

items.title: AT&T Chief Challenges Economics of SpaceX’s Mobile-Network Strategy
items.summary: AT&T CEO John Stankey questions the economics of SpaceX's expanding mobile strategy as regulatory filings and independent measurements show the spectrum, satellite capacity and terrestrial infrastructure involved in scaling direct-to-device service.

items.summary: Shortwave radios offer a way to connect one location on Earth to practically anywhere else with minimal infrastructure. But these radios come with some drawbacks—a significant one being that, unlike satellite communications, their transmission rates for digital data are typically measured in just hundreds of bits per...

items.title: Candle Submarine Cable Reaches Indonesia on Route Across Six Asian Markets
items.summary: The 8,000-kilometre Candle submarine cable has landed in Batam, advancing a six-market Asian system designed for 570 Tbps capacity, 24 fiber pairs and geographically diverse routes ahead of commercial service in 2028.

items.title: FCC doubles down on D2D with spectrum plays
items.summary: The direct-to-device (D2D) market on Thursday received some more love from the FCC, which voted to move forward with proposals to auction 25 megahertz of mid-band spectrum and to modernize rules for D2D services.

items.title: T-Mobile raises profit, adds 274K accounts in Q3
items.summary: T-Mobile grew Q3 profit 27% and added 274,000 postpaid accounts, as its CEO again ruled out a SpaceX MVNO and touted FWA momentum.

items.title: Fiber operator Brightspeed faces potential bankruptcy

items.title: Deutsche Telekom shelves plan to merge with T-Mobile US – report

items.title: Huawei and NISCO put AI to work in the steelworks
items.summary: A Chinese steelmaker is combining probabilistic AI with deterministic industrial models, using Huawei technology to improve furnace operations, product quality and energy efficiency.
